description: Hangs something on a block's side, as near its middle as it fits. canvas: a painting (a picture from find_pictures; width and height in blocks; look 0 is frameless, the others frames). prop: an everyday object (a picture from find_pictures). lamp: width and height 1 or 2. fan: blows away from its side. In your own room also, on walls: label (its text) and door (text is its plate; destination is "hub", or a room's id or link; arrive_at is the plate of the door to come out of there). On a floor or ceiling, top is the way a picture's top points.

on.description: The block's side it hangs on

layer.description: -1 with side up is the room's floor, 16 with side down its ceiling

top.description: On a floor or ceiling, the way a picture's top points: north (the default), south, east or west. Ignored on a wall.

name: add_object
title: Add an object
